proposals.evidence: Turner kīdṛśa explicitly derives Gujarati śũ what through *ksiũ with loss of the vowel. These neighbouring Bhili/Bareli/Gojri hū̃/sū forms are compared with that Gujarati-area interrogative, with local s/h alternation and loss of written nasalization retained. The exact regional contact route remains open.
